seoTitle: House of the Dragon Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the House of the Dragon test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Rhaenyra, Daemon, Alicent, Aemond, Viserys, Otto, Rhaenys or Criston — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the rightful heir, the rogue prince, or the schemer quietly running everything? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, ambition and family, and find out which House of the Dragon character you are.

characters.name: Rhaenyra Targaryen
characters.title: The Rightful Heir
characters.summary: Proud, stubborn and certain of what you're owed. You won't be pushed aside, by anyone.
description: Like Rhaenyra, you know your worth. Her father, King Viserys, named her his heir, and she's never let anyone forget it.
You don't do what's expected. Rhaenyra grew up pushing back against every rule meant to keep her in her place.
You fight for what's yours. When others try to take the throne she was promised, Rhaenyra refuses to back down.
characters.flaw: You think the rules apply to everyone except you.
characters.signature: A crown you were promised, and a dragon called Syrax.
characters.clashReason: they'd remind you, constantly, of what they're owed

characters.name: Daemon Targaryen
characters.title: The Rogue Prince
characters.summary: Reckless, charming and completely unpredictable. You do what you want, and you dare anyone to stop you.
description: Like Daemon, you're impossible to control. They don't call him the Rogue Prince for nothing.
You'd rather act than wait. Judged unfit to rule, Daemon went off and found his own wars to fight.
You know how to make an entrance. Daemon rides the dragon Caraxes and carries the Valyrian steel sword Dark Sister.
characters.flaw: You act on impulse, and other people pay for it.
characters.signature: Dark Sister at your hip and a dragon who answers to nobody else.
characters.clashReason: they'd do something reckless and leave you to deal with it

characters.name: Alicent Hightower
characters.title: The Dutiful Queen
characters.summary: Polite, dutiful and much tougher than you look. You do what's expected of you, until you decide what you want.
description: Like Alicent, you were raised to do the right thing. She's Otto Hightower's daughter, and she became King Viserys's second wife.
You care deeply. Alicent and Rhaenyra were best friends as girls, and their falling-out is what tears the realm apart.
You find your own ambition. Pushed at first by her father's plans, Alicent turns out to be just as ambitious as he is.
characters.flaw: You keep everything inside until it all comes out at once.
characters.signature: A green dress, a perfect smile and a lot left unsaid.
characters.clashReason: they'd smile politely at you and resent you for years

characters.name: Aemond Targaryen
characters.title: The Cold Avenger
characters.summary: Cold, calculating and never, ever forgets. You turn every setback into fuel.
description: Like Aemond, you remember everything. As a boy, he was mocked for being the only one without a dragon.
You take what you're denied. Aemond claimed Vhagar, the biggest dragon alive, and lost an eye to his nephew Lucerys in the fight that followed.
You never let it go. Losing that eye made Aemond colder, and more dangerous, than anyone expected.
characters.flaw: You hold a grudge so long it becomes part of who you are.
characters.signature: An eye patch, a sapphire underneath it and the biggest dragon in the sky.
characters.clashReason: they'd remember every wrong you ever did them

characters.name: Viserys Targaryen
characters.title: The Peacemaker
characters.summary: Kind, warm and desperate for everyone to get along. You'll do almost anything to avoid a fight.
description: Like Viserys, you're kind and generous. He's the king, and he'll be remembered as Viserys the Peaceful.
You hate conflict. Viserys spends his reign trying to stop his family from tearing itself apart.
But you avoid the hard choices. Viserys named Rhaenyra his heir, then let the question of who would really follow him simmer for years.
characters.flaw: You put off difficult conversations until it's too late to have them.
characters.signature: A crown, a kind word for everyone and a family that won't stop fighting.
characters.clashReason: they'd avoid every hard conversation you needed to have

characters.name: Otto Hightower
characters.title: The Schemer
characters.summary: Patient, clever and always playing the long game. You rarely raise your voice, because you rarely need to.
description: Like Otto, you're the one quietly running things. He serves as Hand of the King, the most powerful adviser in the realm.
You play the long game. Otto spends years quietly building support for his grandson Aegon to take the throne.
You use what you've got. Otto pushes his own daughter, Alicent, towards the king to bring his family closer to the crown.
characters.flaw: You treat the people closest to you like pieces in a game.
characters.signature: The Hand of the King's badge and a plan years in the making.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly use you to get what they want

characters.name: Rhaenys Targaryen
characters.title: The Queen Who Never Was
characters.summary: Proud, calm and refreshingly honest. You've seen it all, and you're not afraid to say so.
description: Like Rhaenys, you know you were the best choice, even when nobody chose you. She was passed over for the throne because she's a woman, and she's known as the Queen Who Never Was.
You give people a reality check. Rhaenys is often the calmest, wisest voice in the room.
You don't need to prove yourself. Rhaenys is a fierce dragonrider, and she rides Meleys, the Red Queen.
characters.flaw: You're so proud that you'd rather lose than ask for help.
characters.signature: A crimson dragon and the throne that should have been yours.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly how foolish you're being

characters.name: Criston Cole
characters.title: The Fallen Knight
characters.summary: Loyal, dutiful and quick to take things personally. Hurt you once, and you won't let it go.
description: Like Criston, you've worked for everything you have. He's a common-born knight from the Dornish Marches who earned his place in the Kingsguard.
You take your duty seriously, until it hurts you. Criston broke his vows for Rhaenyra, and he never forgave her, or himself.
You let resentment drive you. Criston switches his loyalty to Alicent's side and rises to Lord Commander of the Kingsguard.
characters.flaw: Once you feel betrayed, nothing will change your mind.
characters.signature: A white cloak, a short temper and a long memory.
characters.clashReason: they'd take everything you said personally

questions.text: You're stuck in a long meeting that's going nowhere. You...

options.text: Point out, politely, that you've all been going round in circles
Say something outrageous, just to wake everyone up
Wait. Once everyone's tired, you'll get your way
Sit through it in silence, getting more and more irritated

questions.text: Two of your friends are fighting, and both want you on their side. You...

options.text: Try to make peace. Can't everyone just get along?
Pick the side that'll be more useful to you later
Try to stay loyal to both, and end up feeling awful
Tell them both exactly how ridiculous they're being

questions.text: Your family starts arguing at a big holiday dinner. You...

options.text: Make one quiet, cutting remark that ruins the whole evening
Stir it up. This is the most fun you've had all year
Stand up and beg everyone to just enjoy the meal together
Refuse to be the one who apologises first

questions.text: Someone you can't stand gets promoted to be your boss. You...

options.text: Stay perfectly polite, even though it's killing you
Make a sharp joke about it, to their face
Stare at them in silence until they get uncomfortable
Make it clear you don't take orders from them

questions.text: You're told to follow a rule you think is stupid. You...

options.text: Argue until they make an exception for you
Follow it. Rules are there for a reason
Explain calmly why it makes no sense, then do it your way
Find the loophole and use it

questions.text: A friend makes a big decision you think is a mistake. You...

options.text: Go along with it. You'd rather not fall out
Warn them once, then let them learn the hard way
Say nothing, and be ready to step in when it goes wrong
Decide they're not worth your time anymore

questions.text: Someone embarrasses you in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Lose your temper completely
Smile coldly. You'll get even, however long it takes
Hold your head high and act like it never touched you
Laugh it off. It's not worth making a scene

questions.text: You're given a big responsibility you never asked for. You...

options.text: Do it perfectly, even if it means you never get to be yourself
Throw yourself into it. Duty comes first
Get bored within a week and go off to find something more exciting
Take it on, and start doing it your way

questions.text: A friend betrays your trust. You...

options.text: Never forgive them. You'd have done anything for them
Feel hurt, then spend years trying to prove you were the one in the right
Forgive them. Life's too short for grudges
Act like nothing happened, and remember it forever

questions.text: Someone challenges you in front of the people you're in charge of. You...

options.text: Put them in their place, loudly and dramatically
Look them in the eye and remind them who they're talking to
Thank them for their input, then quietly make sure they never get promoted
Accept the challenge. You've been training for this your whole life

questions.text: You're a royal, and the king has just named someone else heir to a throne you thought was yours. You...

options.text: Accept it with dignity. Everyone knows who should have had it
Storm off to a war far away and make a name for yourself
Bide your time. One day you'll take what you're owed
Swear yourself to whoever will actually reward your loyalty

questions.text: You ride a dragon, and war has just broken out inside your own family. You...

options.text: Fight for what's yours. You were promised that throne
Do anything to stop it. Family shouldn't fight family
Secretly try to make peace with your old friend on the other side
Ride out first. Someone has to show them you mean it
